meta_description: Daws Electrical Services in Leeds. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, fuseboard upgrades, and emergency repairs. Call 07706 667829 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From rewires and fuseboard upgrades to emergency callouts, Daws Electrical handles domestic and commercial jobs with precision and care.
services_subhead: We handle everything from small repairs to major installations, serving homeowners and businesses throughout the Leeds area.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, faulty sockets — we diagnose and fix faults fast. Same-day callouts available, any time of day.

services.title: Fuseboard & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuseboard? We'll replace it with a modern consumer unit to improve safety and add RCD protection throughout your home.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Rewiring an older property or upgrading to modern standards? We handle the lot, minimising disruption and leaving your electrics safe and up to code.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Electrics
services.desc: New sockets, lighting, extractor fans, and heated towel rails fitted to Building Regulations. Perfect for refits and renovations.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Installation
services.desc: Office rewires, shop fit-outs, and switchboard work. We understand commercial timescales and minimise downtime.

services.title: Testing, Inspection & Certification
services.desc: EICR reports and periodic testing to confirm your electrics are safe. Essential for landlords and businesses.

about_pullquote: I do the job right the first time, and I treat your home with respect.
about_para_1: Daws Electrical Services has been serving Leeds households and businesses for over 15 years. We started out doing small repairs and have grown by word-of-mouth into one of the area's most trusted electrical contractors. Every job — whether it's a simple socket swap or a full rewire — is completed to Building Regulations standard.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, fair pricing, and turning up when we say we will. We carry most parts on the van, so many jobs are finished the same day. If you've had a bad experience with another electrician, we'll come and put it right.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Customers Say About Daws Electrical

reviews.text: Had a total rewire done earlier this year. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished a day ahead of schedule. Wired in new cooker circuit and upgraded the board at the same time. Really pleased with the job. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Emergency callout on a Sunday evening — electrics went down. Dave was here within 45 minutes and had us back on within the hour. Didn't charge us the earth either. Brilliant service, will use them again.
reviews.author: Janet L.

reviews.text: Fuseboard was ancient and dodgy. Dave sorted it out properly, explained everything, and the new board's so much safer. Fair price and no faffing about. Can't ask for more really.
reviews.author: Paul B.
